nouvelle-vague.label: Nouvelle Vague
nouvelle-vague.note: The French New Wave has no formal membership. This list takes the Cahiers du cinéma core plus the Left Bank group, which is the standard critical grouping. Films released 1958-1973 are flagged as the movement's active period; later films by the same directors are still included so the database is complete. Jean-Pierre Melville is a acknowledged precursor rather than a member and is already covered by the top-50 directors list.
